# QR Code generator

Nayuki QR Code generator v1.8.0, standalone C sources, unchanged.
MIT license is included in both source file headers.

- https://github.com/nayuki/QR-Code-generator/tree/v1.8.0/c
- https://www.nayuki.io/page/qr-code-generator-library

Used directly for the 1bpp framebuffer; no LVGL dependency, heap allocation,
remote QR generation, or token-bearing QR payloads.

- `qrcodegen.c` SHA256: `300eff07ee25baaa7578f20284411638154716379437391e7e689c0e6ce81403`
- `qrcodegen.h` SHA256: `e82df4bff37d18b5863b9e7486fe6bda1b6cda8c3b9ecebfec473907265cb589`
